title: The frames of the app host of Air on its links
description: One line of the corpus of air-apps. A message of one link is the def <Link>Message: AppMessage for the stdio of an app, PageMessage for the WebSocket of the host page, FrameMessage for the postMessage of a frame, IdeMessage for the frames of air-apps on the connection of air-ide. The string ${any} matches any value, and ${<name>} binds a value at its first place and matches it after.

Id.description: The id of a request. The answer carries it verbatim.

Version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without a leading zero, a pre-release or a build part.

Instance.description: The id of one instance of a view, which air-ide gives. It is never used twice in one run of air-ide.

Mirror.description: The key of a mirror of the app, which the app gives, such as the path of a repository. The views that show the same state share one mirror.

AppViewChannel.description: A held channel of the page link that mirrors one mirror of the app.

AppsChannel.description: The held channel of the IDE link with the apps of one project.

Origin.description: Who asked for a call. click: a frame of a view. action: an action of the app file or of a notification. agent: the proxy tool air_app of a session.

Reason.description: The kind of an error of the x-air-app vocabulary, in data.reason. A receiver ignores a field that it does not know.

stderrTail.description: The last lines of the stderr of a process that exited, at most 20.

ErrorObject.description: A JSON-RPC error. -32001 badTicket, -32002 serverExited and notStarted, -32003 connectionLost, -32004 tooLarge, -32008 unknownChannel and unknownInstance, -32009 noConsent, agentOrigin, notHolder and modelOnly, -32601 unknownMethod and unknownTool, -32800 cancelled; the other codes are those of JSON-RPC and of air-ide.

ViewOp.description: One change of the state of a mirror by the table rule of air-host: part replaces one part, set puts one entry of a part by its key, remove deletes it.

ViewChanged.description: The one state action of an app view channel: the ops of one change of the app, applied in order.

ViewContext.description: What the view of a frame shows: the IDE gives it, and the page never sets it.

Run.description: As Run of air-app.schema.json: a call of a tool with the origin action, or the open of a view.

CallMeta.description: _meta["x-air-app"] of a tools/call that air-ide sends: the origin and the app; the view and the instance of a click; the action of an action, and the view and the instance of a title action.

visibility.description: Who may call the tool. model: an agent through air_app, with agent.tools model and its consent. app: a frame of a view (origin click) and an action of the app file or of a notification (origin action). Without it, both.

AppInitializeResult.description: An app without experimental["x-air-app"] is a plain MCP server: it serves tools, and no view.

reason.description: sessionClosed: the app no longer serves the mirror. An app cannot tell a gone repository from a closed session, so version 1 has no other reason.

AppMessage.description: One message of the app link: MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 over the stdio of the app, one object per line.

ticket.description: At least 32 characters of base64url, once: the ticket of the fragment of the address of the host document, or of window.airAppHost.connect.

reason.description: closed: air-ide closed the channel for another cause. serverExited: the process of the app exited. sessionClosed: the app ended the mirror (x-air-app/viewEnded). A receiver reads an unknown reason as closed.

PageMessage.description: One message of the page link: one JSON-RPC 2.0 object in one text frame of the WebSocket. Every params has channel, as on the connection of air-ide.

FrameInitializeResult.description: hostContext["x-air-app"] is present when the frame offered the extension and the host serves it.

FrameMessage.description: One message of the frame link: MCP Apps JSON-RPC 2.0 by postMessage between the frame of a view and the host page.

AppEntry.description: One app of the apps channel. A project entry of genui-apps.json has no views, no actions and no instances.

state.description: starting: a first start or a restart of the user, until the process is ready. restarting: from an exit until the process of the backoff restart is ready. failed: the fourth exit in a row, or a refused process.

generation.description: Grows with each restart of the process: a new generation reloads the frame with a new ticket.

connected.description: True while a WebSocket of a host page holds the instance by its ticket. When it turns false while the place stays, the IDE gives the loaded page of the instance a new ticket, unless it loads the page again itself.

oneOf.description: The life of a place. The result of the echo is {changed}: whether the shown state of the instance flipped, an instance starting hidden, or for a close whether the instance left the channel. The app hears each report.
An action of the app file. instance names the instance whose place shows the action, such as a title action of a tool window; the call then names its view and its instance.

AppsAction.description: A state action of the apps channel by the table rule: one app entry set or removed by its id.

AppViewTicketResult.description: The answer of x-air-ide/appViewTicket. The IDE loads <pageUrl>#ticket=<ticket> in a new browser of the instance, or gives the ticket to the loaded page of the instance by window.airAppHost.connect(ticket) in its main frame. The page opens its WebSocket on the origin of pageUrl.

ticket.description: At least 32 characters of base64url, once.

pageUrl.description: The host document of the page entry of air-ide, http://127.0.0.1:<port>/, the same for each ticket of one run.

params.description: A root command: the request handler of the IDE reads one file of a frame of an app, ui://<app>/<path>, and gets the ReadResourceResult of the app as it wrote it.

name.description: A tool of the IDE: air_copy, air_open_file, air_show_diff, air_show_commit or air_navigate. The badge, the progress and a notification are requests of the app, x-air-app/setBadge, setProgress and notify, and no host tool.

IdeMessage.description: One message of the IDE link: the frames of air-apps on the connection of air-ide, in its vocabulary x-air-ide.

LinkFrame.description: One message on one link, from one end. A runner of one end sends the messages of the other end and checks its own.

conn.description: The connection of the line when its link has more than one at a time: a WebSocket of the link page by the order of its handshake, and a connection of the link ide by the order of its initialize, from 1. Without it, the line is on the last one of its link that opened.

raw.description: A line or a text frame that is no JSON message, as sent.

binary.description: A binary frame of a WebSocket, its bytes in base64.

Step.description: An event of the world that a runner makes happen or expects. A runner skips a step that its end cannot see. httpRequest sends one HTTP request without an upgrade and expects its status, the headers by their lowercase names and the exact body. pageLoad is the load of the host document by the IDE and the address of the page after it. pageShow, pageTheme and pageTicket are the calls window.airAppHost.show({frame, theme}), setTheme(theme) and connect(ticket) of the IDE in the main frame of a loaded page. A runner of air-ide skips the four page steps.

frame.description: The frame of the view that pageShow mounts: the resource of the view on the origin of its app.

theme.description: The theme of the IDE that pageShow and pageTheme give the page, as the IDE captures it: dark, and the values of its colors.

StateCheck.description: The mirror of a channel or a subscription after the lines before it, by the table rule.
